== Notes == 
* When used by an [[Assassin]] who's not wielding a ranged [[weapon]], the skill uses the falling attack animation similar to that of [[Falling Spider]], instead of a normal skill activation animation. 
* This skill has excellent synergy with [[List of adrenaline-related skills|adrenaline gain increase skills]] and [[Stonefist Insignia]]. With [[Dragon Slash]] and [["For Great Justice!"]] in the same [[build]] as this skill, one can keep a foe continuously knocked down for over 20 seconds. With the addition of an [[IAS]], you don't even need "For Great Justice!", making it useful for [[Shutdown|shutting down]] high damage output [[boss]]es.
* This skill deals [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor-ignoring]] [[physical damage]].
{{anomaly|This skill has no [[aftercast delay]].}}

== Trivia ==
* The figure in the [[skill icon]] appears to be [[Dagnar Stonepate]] in his [[Warrior]] model, unseated from his [[Ice Drake]].
